cases.script:
set -e
umask 0777
sshd keygen -f "$HOME/new-key"
umask 022
printf stale > "$HOME/existing-key.pub"
chmod 0644 "$HOME/existing-key.pub"
sshd keygen -f "$HOME/existing-key"
/usr/bin/python3 - "$HOME" <<'PYEOF'
import os, pathlib, stat, sys
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
for name in ('new-key', 'existing-key'):
    for suffix, expected in (('', b'BASHSSHD-HOSTKEY ed25519\n'), ('.pub', b'sshd-ed25519 AAAABASHOSHOSTKEY\n')):
        p = root / (name + suffix)
        print('%s mode=%04o bytes=%s' % (p.name, stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode), 'exact' if p.read_bytes() == expected else 'different'))
PYEOF
cases.stdout:
new-key mode=0600 bytes=exact
new-key.pub mode=0600 bytes=exact
existing-key mode=0600 bytes=exact
existing-key.pub mode=0600 bytes=exact
cases.oracle: Documented native placeholder bytes and mode 0600 on both files; restrictive umask and an existing 0644 sidecar exercise creation and overwrite.
cases.comparison: Exact private and public bytes and both modes for each invocation; set -e requires successful key generation.

cases.stdout: unsafe key paths refused; sentinel intact
cases.oracle: Placeholder generation requires both regular files with mode 0600; a sidecar symlink or directory cannot be used as a key file.
cases.comparison: Require failure for each unsafe path and unchanged symlink target content and permissions.
cases.script:
set -e
printf sentinel > "$HOME/sentinel"
chmod 0644 "$HOME/sentinel"
ln -s "$HOME/sentinel" "$HOME/symlink-private"
if sshd keygen -f "$HOME/symlink-private" >out 2>err; then exit 1; fi
[[ $(<"$HOME/sentinel") == sentinel && $(stat -c %a "$HOME/sentinel") == 644 ]]
ln -s "$HOME/sentinel" "$HOME/symlink-public.pub"
if sshd keygen -f "$HOME/symlink-public" >out 2>err; then exit 2; fi
[[ $(<"$HOME/sentinel") == sentinel && $(stat -c %a "$HOME/sentinel") == 644 ]]
mkfifo "$HOME/fifo-private"
if sshd keygen -f "$HOME/fifo-private" >out 2>err; then exit 4; fi
mkdir "$HOME/dir-public.pub"
if sshd keygen -f "$HOME/dir-public" >out 2>err; then exit 3; fi
printf 'unsafe key paths refused; sentinel intact\n'
